# CursorUp

> > CursorUp is a curated design inspiration gallery and resource hub featuring hundreds of website examples, design portfolios, and free tools for product and UX/UI designers.

CursorUp serves as a comprehensive design inspiration platform with 78,000+ monthly visitors, founded by Craig Barber. The site curates the best website designs across multiple categories while providing free design resources, tools, and a community for designers.

## Key Topics

- Design Gallery & Inspiration
- Portfolio Examples
- UI/UX Design
- Web Design Showcase
- Startup Websites
- Agency Websites
- Ecommerce Design
- Design Resources & Tools
- Product Design
- Design Community
- Landing Page Optimization
- Conversion Rate Optimization
- Design Portfolios
- Web Design Trends
- Design Tools

## Design Gallery & Inspiration

- [CursorUp - 100's of Inspiring Website Design Examples](https://www.cursorup.com): CursorUp homepage showcasing website design inspiration and gallery
- [101 Jaw-Dropping Design Portfolios: Get Inspired Now!](https://www.cursorup.com/sites/portfolio): Curated collection of inspiring design portfolio examples and showcases
- [10 Design Agency Websites That Will Blow Your Mind!](https://www.cursorup.com/sites/agency): Showcase of best design agency websites for inspiration and ideas
- [10 Startup Websites That Broke the Internet with Their Design!](https://www.cursorup.com/sites/startup): Curated startup website designs showcasing innovative web design trends
- [Revolutionize Your Online Store: Top 10 Ecommerce Designs of the Year!](https://www.cursorup.com/sites/ecommerce): Top ecommerce website designs featuring best practices and examples

## Design Resources & Tools

- [100's of FREE Resources for Product / UX & UI Designers](https://www.cursorup.com/resources): Free design resources including tools, fonts, UI kits, and stock assets
- [CursorUp Blog](https://www.cursorup.com/blog): Blog covering design resources, UI/UX, and digital product design topics

## Conversion & Growth

- [Crazy Conversions - Landing Page Playbook - Boost Your Sales Today](https://www.cursorup.com/crazy): Landing page optimization playbook for conversion rate and sales growth
